answer: Grant capacity only to identities that maintain a continuously sampled, sequential heartbeat from a scarce physical resource; each heartbeat includes an unpredictable nonce and must arrive within a narrow interval for 30 days. A pulse sensor, delta log, or velvet renderer is paid only after the live stream proves continuity. A Sybil farmer must rent separate machines, links, and power for every alias, so copying keys cannot copy elapsed time.
